- Added puzzle Shakedown
- Discord: Sealed Deck is now playable end to end -- build a deck from your pool (or take the suggested one), then play a best-of-three match against a practice bot or a friend
- Discord: Practice, Friend and Power Duel games can now be played as a best of three, with the match score on the board, a "Next game" button, and the first-player choice for games 2 and 3
- Discord: the board now shows an "Advance Turn" button when your turn is paused, so a game can no longer get stuck there
- The internal PuzzleOpponent account no longer appears in the New Game practice-bot list
